summary: Candidate is a broader session-level knowledge_reference that subsumes the peer candidate 44a0fe37 (Types 1–4 taxonomy). Both classify route leaks by policy violation context with identical asset_type, granularity, asset_node_id, and task_family. The candidate extends the taxonomy to cover six documented types and adds workflow steps for identifying offending AS and route origin/destination relationships. Merge into the existing Types 1–4 skill and deprecate the narrower peer candidate, as the candidate provides the complete taxonomy reference.
